mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teampack.team (team_name, assignment_title, due_date) VALUES (#{teamName}, #{assignmentTitle}, #{dueDate})
mapper.select: SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, t.assignment_title, t.due_date, t.closed_at, m.member_type FROM teampack.team t JOIN teampack.members m ON t.team_id = m.team_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, t.assignment_title, t.due_date, t.closed_at, m.member_type FROM teampack.team t JOIN teampack.members m ON t.team_id = m.team_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT m.member_id, m.team_id, m.user_id, u.user_name, m.member_type,m.member_role, up.user_image_url FROM teampack.members m JOIN teampack.users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN teampack.user_profile_images up ON m.user_id = up.user_id WHERE m.team_id = #{teamId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM teampack.members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}

AND (t.closed_at IS NULL) AND (t.due_date IS NULL OR t.due_date > NOW())
